features.summary: Normalized local concept for web-operation-job-lifecycle. Validated observations: Job terminal metadata leaves cancellation and denial unexplained: WebOperationJob requires finished_at_utc for completed, failed, cancelled, and timeout, but requires failure_reason_code only for failed and timeout; denied has neither conditional requirement, and the reason code has no minimum length. | Web job lifecycle is a vocabulary, not a state machine: The job schema enumerates statuses but defines no allowed transitions, timestamp ordering, concurrency token, or coupling between status and the independent cancelled boolean. | Cache policy does not enforce privacy or lifecycle decisions: CachePolicy has no required fields or conditional invariants connecting store, max_age_seconds, cache_key_ref, and redaction_profile_id. | Payload success can contradict embedded job status: The required payload success boolean and optional embedded job status have no consistency rule, and there is no revision or concurrency field to adjudicate competing result and job updates. | Failed and denied calls may be explanation-free: denial_reason_code, error_code, error_message, warnings, and job are optional and no conditional requires any of them when success is false or a job is denied, failed, cancelled, or timed out.
features.title: Web Operation Job Lifecycle
